intent: Stand in for a list, table or panel that has settled with nothing to show, explaining why and offering a way forward.
typical_uses: A list, table or search result that returned zero items
A first-run panel shown before any data exists

dont_use_when.situation: Data is still loading and the region is not yet known to be empty
A short loading indicator with no layout to hold
A status or error message about the page, such as a failed request
A bounded container around real content that is present

invariants.text: Empty and every part render a plain div with no role, no aria attribute and no live region of their own; appearing or disappearing announces nothing to assistive tech.
The root is a flex column that centers its children on the cross axis, center-aligns its text, spaces its direct children var(--space-6) apart and caps its own width at 32rem inside a dashed border.

good.title: A search with no results, an icon, a detail line and two actions
good.code:
<Empty>
  <EmptyHeader>
    <EmptyMedia variant="icon">
      <SearchIcon />
    </EmptyMedia>
    <EmptyTitle>No results</EmptyTitle>
    <EmptyDescription>Try a different search term or clear your filters.</EmptyDescription>
    <EmptyDetail>3 filters applied</EmptyDetail>
  </EmptyHeader>
  <EmptyActions>
    <Button onClick={createFirst}>New project</Button>
    <Button variant="outline" onClick={clearFilters}>Clear filters</Button>
  </EmptyActions>
</Empty>

bad.title: Empty rendered while the request is still in flight
bad.why: The user reads "no projects yet" during the load and then sees rows appear; a loading state belongs to Skeleton or Spinner, and Empty only to a settled empty result.
